VOICE
The key is saved on this device with your AI settings and is sent only to your Fish base URL. In a web browser Fish blocks the call (CORS), so nothing is spoken and the error is shown until your proxy forwards Fish — the desktop app connects directly.
The voice field is the ElevenLabs voice_id — it is required, pick one from your ElevenLabs voice library. The key is saved on this device and sent only to your ElevenLabs base URL.
The voice field is a Gemini prebuilt voice name (Kore, Puck, Zephyr…). The key is saved on this device and sent only to your Gemini base URL.
Any OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint: MIRA posts to {base}/audio/speech with {model, input, voice, response_format: "mp3"} and plays the returned audio. The key is saved on this device and sent only to that endpoint.
